Class ScalaAnnotationRemovalVisitor

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.scala.processing.test.ScalaAnnotationRemovalVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered, io.micronaut.core.util.Toggleable, io.micronaut.inject.visitor.TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
public final class ScalaAnnotationRemovalVisitor extends Object implements io.micronaut.inject.visitor.TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
Test visitor that takes annotations off a visited class.

Removal is the half of element mutation nothing here could reach. ScalaElementMutationVisitor only adds, and adding is forgiving: an annotation written twice is the same as written once. Taking one away has to reach the same metadata the plugin built, and a removal that silently misses leaves the bean exactly as it was.
